Mach den nächsten Schritt von der Baustelle in den Verkauf

Du kennst den Baustellenalltag aus erster Hand und willst dich weiterentwickeln?
Dann nutze dein Praxiswissen dort, wo es den grössten Unterschied macht: im direkten Kundenkontakt.
Bei uns wird deine Erfahrung zum echten Vorteil. Du berätst auf Augenhöhe, verstehst die Herausforderungen vor Ort und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen für deine Kunden.
Du startest in einem unterstützenden Team, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und gestaltest dein eigenes Verkaufsgebiet im Grossraum Luzern aktiv mit.

Dein Profil

• Berufserfahrung in der Baubranche (z. B. Hochbau, Tiefbau, als Maurer:in oder vergleichbar)

• Motivation, in den Verkauf einzusteigen und dich gezielt weiterzuentwickeln

• Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Italienischkenntnisse

• Führerausweis Kategorie B

Impressum

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt, bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz zu arbeiten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung. Deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, CV, Zeugnisse) nehmen wir ausschliesslich über unser Online-Karrieretool entgegen. Frau Manuela Ancora, HR Talent Partner, freut sich auf dein Anschreiben und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung: chteamhrrecruiting@hilti.com

Was kannst du erwarten, wenn du dich bei Hilti bewirbst?
	· Wir verpflichten uns, alle Bewerbungen von einem Menschen prüfen zu lassen. Auch wenn niemand unfehlbar ist, stehen wir bei allem, was wir tun, zu unserem personenzentrierten Ansatz.
	· Sobald du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du automatische Benachrichtigungen von unserem System (ausgelöst durch unser Rekrutierungsteam).
	· Bewerbungen, die es nicht bis zum Vorstellungsgespräch mit einem einstellenden Manager schaffen, erhalten kein personalisiertes Feedback.
	· Du kannst davon ausgehen, dass du innerhalb von 2–3 Wochen (im Durchschnitt) von uns hörst – unabhängig vom Ergebnis. Der gesamte Einstellungsprozess kann zwischen 5 und 6 Wochen dauern.
	· Wir wünschen dir viel Erfolg in deinem Bewerbungsverfahren. Tipps zur Bewerbung und zum Vorstellungsgespräch findest du in unseren häufig gestellten Fragen zur Karriere.
Sollten technische Probleme während der Bewerbung auftreten, kontaktiere bitte mycareer-techsupport@hilti.com.

Verpflichtung zur Inklusion

Inklusion ist bei Hilti ein zentraler Aspekt unserer Arbeitsweise, unseres Führungsstils und unseres gemeinsamen Wachstums. Wir engagieren uns aktiv für Gedankenvielfalt und ein Umfeld, das für alle und überall inklusiv ist. Wir streben fortlaufend danach, dass jede Stimme gehört wird und sich jedes Teammitglied befähigt fühlt, sich einzubringen. Indem wir dieses Fundament schaffen, stärken wir unsere Teams, unsere Innovation und unsere Wirkung, um gemeinsam das Bauwesen zu verbessern.

Warum Hilti

Hilti ist ein global führendes Unternehmen in der Bauinnovation mit mehr als 34.000 Teammitgliedern in 120 Ländern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Bauwesen zu verbessern. Deshalb liegt es uns am Herzen, zu lernen, zu wachsen und neue Wege zu finden, eine bleibende Wirkung zu erzielen. Hier kannst Du Deine Stärken einbringen, mit einem globalen und inklusiven Team zusammenarbeiten und Dich sinnvollen Herausforderungen stellen. Bei Hilti kannst Du Deine Ideen durch zielgerichtetes Handeln, Leidenschaft und Teamwork in reale Errungenschaften und Wachstum verwandeln.

Take the next step from the construction site to the sales You know the everyday work on the construction site first hand and want to take the next step? Then bring your practical knowledge into sales: You advise customers on an equal footing and develop your own customer portfolio in the greater Lucerne area. You start in a strong team, get a lot of trust and space and work hands-on and self-responsible from the beginning. Your construction experience is not a “nice-to-have”, but your clear advantage in customer contact. Your profile
• Experience or background in the construction industry (e.g. building or civil engineering, mason:in)
• Motivation to get into sales and grow
• Fluent language skills in German and Italian
• Enjoying direct customer contact and self-responsible work
• Place of residence in the Lucerne region
• Category B driving licence Imprint Have we aroused your interest in working for one of the best employers in Switzerland? Then we look forward to your meaningful online application. We accept your complete documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) exclusively via our online career tool. Ms. Manuela Ancora, HR Talent Partner, is looking forward to receiving your cover letter and is at your disposal for any questions: chteamhrrecruiting@hilti.com What can you expect when applying to Hilti? · We undertake to have all applications reviewed by one person. Even if no one is infallible, we stand by our person-centered approach to everything we do. · Once you submit your application, you will receive automatic notifications from our system (triggered by our recruitment team). · Applications that do not make it to the interview with a hiring manager do not receive personalized feedback. · You can expect to hear from us within 2–3 weeks (on average) regardless of the result. The entire recruitment process can take between 5 and 6 weeks. · We wish you every success in your application process. Tips for applying and interviewing can be found in our frequently asked career questions. If technical problems occur during the application, please contact mycareer-techsupport@hilti.com. At Hilti, commitment to inclusion is a central aspect of our way of working, our leadership style and our shared growth. We are actively committed to diversity of thought and an environment that is inclusive for everyone and everywhere. We continue to strive for every voice to be heard and for every team member to feel empowered to contribute. By building this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation and our impact to collectively improve construction. Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation with more than 34,000 team members in 120 countries. Our goal is to improve construction. That’s why we care about learning, growing and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here you can contribute your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team and face meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you can turn your ideas into real achievements and growth through purposeful action, passion and teamwork.

jobs.title: Intern – Data & AI Product Owner (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
What's the role?

The Data & AI Product Owner team is part of the Analytics Center of Excellence at Hilti and plays a key role in unlocking the value of our data for Hilti and our customers. Working closely together with business functions, we help shape the vision and roadmap for data and AI solutions across different business areas and actively develop the solution portfolio at Hilti. As a Data & AI Visiting Product Owner Intern you will get the opportunity to work on the most relevant data & AI driven use cases found in a large organization that is leading the digital transformation in the construction sector.

The start date for the internship is flexible based on your availability; however, a March start is preferred. The expected duration is six months

What You’ll Bring

• · Enrolled in a Master’s or PhD program in Data Science, Information Systems, or related fields for the internship period
• · Strong ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions
• · Comprehensive understanding of the full lifecycle of data and AI solutions—from ideation and ML modeling to operational deployment, change management, and success measurement (e.g., A/B testing)
• · Solid knowledge of cloud data platforms, data engineering, as well as Generative AI and Machine Learning
• · Proven leadership without formal authority; demonstrates ownership, ambition, and influence

Legal Notice

Hilti is an equal opportunity employer.

Commitment to Inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

La data di inizio dello stage è flessibile in base alla vostra disponibilità; tuttavia, un inizio di marzo è preferito. La durata prevista è di sei mesi

• · Solida conoscenza delle piattaforme di dati cloud, dell'ingegneria dei dati, dell'intelligenza artificiale e dell'apprendimento automatico
• · Prova leadership senza autorità formale; dimostra la proprietà, l'ambizione e l'influenza

Hilti è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Was ist die Rolle?

Das Data & AI Product Owner Team ist Teil des Analytics Center of Excellence bei Hilti und spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Wertschöpfung unserer Daten für Hilti und unsere Kunden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsfunktionen gestalten wir die Vision und Roadmap für Daten- und KI-Lösungen in verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen mit und entwickeln das Lösungsportfolio bei Hilti aktiv weiter. Als Data & AI Visiting Product Owner Intern erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, an den relevantesten daten- und ki-getriebenen Anwendungsfällen einer großen Organisation zu arbeiten, die die digitale Transformation im Bausektor anführt.

Der Starttermin für das Praktikum ist flexibel basierend auf Ihrer Verfügbarkeit; jedoch wird ein März-Start bevorzugt. Die erwartete Dauer beträgt sechs Monate

Was du mitbringen wirst

• · Eingeschrieben in einem Master- oder PhD-Programm in Data Science, Information Systems oder verwandten Bereichen für die Praktikumszeit
• Starke Fähigkeit, die Lücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technologischen Lösungen zu schließen
• Umfassendes Verständnis des gesamten Lebenszyklus von Daten und KI-Lösungen – von Ideenfindung und ML-Modellierung bis hin zu operativer Bereitstellung, Change Management und Erfolgsmessung (z. B. A / B-Tests)
• Solides Wissen über Cloud-Datenplattformen, Data Engineering sowie Generative AI und Machine Learning
• · Nachgewiesene Führung ohne formale Autorität; zeigt Besitz, Ehrgeiz und Einfluss

Rechtliche Hinweise

Hilti ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Engagement für Inklusion

We are looking for you – a committed and flexible personality who enjoys customer contact and is ready to step in at various Hilti stores in Switzerland. You are service-oriented, communicative and have a high willingness to travel. You want to create a unique shopping experience for every customer and to present our products convincingly. You recognize the individual needs of the customers and enjoy finding the right solution. You act proactively, work goal-oriented and are motivated to exploit the full potential of customers and Hilti stores.

Would you like to help shape the Hilti Store landscape of the future? If so, then you are the right person to join and advance our store team!
The job is possible in both 100% and job sharing with 50-70% per person.

Your profile

Because you are a capable networker who likes to finish topics. Because a sustainable customer relationship is more important to you than rapid success. Because you are of the “entrepreneur” type: initiative, independent and success-oriented. Because you want to work for a first-class brand that opens doors for you. Because you want to develop professionally.

• · Graduated university (bachelor) and/or further education
• · Experience in sales and customer advice is an advantage
• · Strong service orientation, initiative and flexibility
• · Willingness to intervene regularly and flexibly in different regions
• · Good IT skills; Experience with SAP and Salesforce benefits
• · Very good knowledge of German and French
• · Category B driving licence

Imprint

Have we aroused your interest in working for one of the best employers in Switzerland? Then we look forward to your meaningful online application. Please submit your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV and certificates) exclusively via our online career tool. If you have any questions, Manuela Ancora is at your disposal at chteamhrrecruiting@hilti.com.

Commitment to inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a central aspect of our way of working, our leadership style and our shared growth. We are actively committed to diversity of thought and an environment that is inclusive for everyone and everywhere. We continue to strive for every voice to be heard and for every team member to feel empowered to contribute. By building this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation and our impact to collectively improve construction.

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation with more than 34,000 team members in 120 countries. Our goal is to improve construction. That’s why we care about learning, growing and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here you can contribute your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team and face meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you can turn your ideas into real achievements and growth through purposeful action, passion and teamwork.

Pour notre équipe Customer Master Data (département des fichiers clients), nous recherchons une personnalité fiable et analytique, dotée d’un sens aigu de la qualité et de l’organisation. Dans cette fonction, vous veillez à ce que nos données clients soient structurées de manière correcte, complète et pérenne. Vous évoluez à l’interface de différents domaines d’activité, analysez des structures clients complexes et trouvez des solutions techniques pour répondre à des exigences pointues.
Ce poste convient particulièrement aux personnes qui aiment travailler de manière concentrée, comprendre les liens entre les différents éléments et développer continuellement leur expertise dans un processus central de l’entreprise. Grâce à votre contribution, vous créez les bases permettant à nos équipes de collaborer chaque jour de manière efficace et performante avec nos clients.

Vos atouts pour ce poste

• Formation commerciale, technique ou formation équivalente

• Expérience dans l’utilisation de systèmes ERP ainsi que de bonnes connaissances de MS Office; des connaissances de SAP (en particulier module SD et/ou FI) constituent un atout

• Intérêt marqué pour le travail avec les données, des systèmes et les structures complexes

• Grande précision, patience et persévérance ainsi qu’une approche analytique et structurée

• Excellentes connaissances du français et de l’allemand ; des connaissances en anglais constituent un atout

Mentions légales

Avons-nous éveillé ton intérêt à travailler pour l’un des meilleurs employeurs de Suisse ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir ta candidature en ligne.
Merci de nous transmettre ton dossier complet (dans un seul document PDF incluant lettre de motivation, CV, certificats, etc.) exclusivement via notre plateforme de recrutement en ligne.
Madame Joèlle Ochsner, HR Talent Partner, se réjouit de recevoir ta candidature.

À quoi peux-tu t’attendre en postulant chez Hilti ?

• Nous nous engageons à ce que toutes les candidatures soient examinées par une personne. Même si nul n’est infaillible, notre approche reste centrée sur l’humain dans tout ce que nous faisons.

• Après le dépôt de ta candidature, tu recevras des notifications automatiques de notre système (déclenchées par notre équipe de recrutement).

• Les candidatures qui ne sont pas retenues pour un entretien avec un responsable du recrutement ne reçoivent pas de retour personnalisé.

• Tu peux t’attendre à recevoir une réponse de notre part dans un délai moyen de 2 à 3 semaines, quel que soit le résultat. Le processus complet de recrutement peut durer entre 5 et 6 semaines.

Nous te souhaitons plein succès dans ton processus de candidature. Tu trouveras des conseils pour ta candidature et tes entretiens dans notre FAQ carrière.

En cas de problème technique lors de ta candidature, merci de contacter : mycareer-techsupport@hilti.com.

Engagement en faveur de l'inclusion

Chez Hilti, l'inclusion guide notre manière de travailler, de diriger et de progresser ensemble. Nous nous engageons à valoriser la diversité des points de vue et à créer un environnement inclusif partout et pour chacun. Nous veillons à ce que chaque voix soit entendue et que chaque membre de l'équipe puisse contribuer. En nous appuyant sur cette base, nous renforçons nos équipes, notre capacité d'innovation et notre impact, pour améliorer le secteur de la construction ensemble.

Pourquoi choisir Hilti

Hilti est un leader mondial de l’innovation dans la construction, avec plus de 34 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 120 pays. Guidés par notre raison d’être – "Making Construction Better" (Améliorer le secteur de la Construction) – nous sommes animés par l’envie d’apprendre, de grandir et de trouver de nouvelles façons d’avoir un impact durable. En rejoignant Hilti, vous serez encouragé.e à mettre en valeur vos forces, à travailler avec une équipe mondiale et inclusive, et à relever des défis stimulants. Ici, vos idées comptent: vous aurez la possibilité de concrétiser vos projets, vos réussites et votre développement grâce à la passion, la collaboration et l'engagement.

Costruire questa fondazione, rafforziamo i nostri team, la nostra innovazione e il nostro impatto per migliorare collettivamente la costruzione.

Perché Hilti

Hilti è leader globale nell'innovazione costruttiva con oltre 34.000 membri del team in 120 paesi. Il nostro obiettivo è migliorare la costruzione. Ecco perché ci interessa imparare, crescere e trovare nuovi modi per avere un impatto duraturo. Qui puoi contribuire ai tuoi punti di forza, lavorare con un team globale e inclusivo e affrontare sfide significative. A Hilti, puoi trasformare le tue idee in realizzazioni e crescita reali attraverso azioni mirate, passione e lavoro di squadra.

Shape your sustainable partnerships in the building environment!

Looking after Hilti You are not just a customer, but develop strategic partnerships with an existing large customer portfolio in Graubünden. As a Key Account Sales Advisor: Responsible You will explore the revenue potential of your area and use market analysis, entrepreneurial thinking and consulting skills to create sustainable growth. Whether on the construction site, in the magazine or in conversation with the management: You recognize individual needs and convince with innovative products, digital solutions and services from the entire Hilti portfolio. In this way, you become a reliable counterpart for your customers and actively shape the future of the construction industry.
The job is possible in both 100% and job sharing with 50-70% per person.

Your profile

• Several years of experience in field sales or in a responsible management function, e.g. as project or team leader:

• Completed training as a sales specialist or techn. Merchant/merchant wife of advantage

• Strong analytical and strategic skills as well as a structured, entrepreneurial way of working

• High consulting skills, negotiation skills and the ability to build sustainable relationships at all hierarchical levels

• Flowing knowledge of German and Swiss

• Category B driving licence

Imprint

Have we aroused your interest in working for one of the best employers in Switzerland? Then we look forward to your online application. We accept your complete documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online career tool. Ms. Joèlle Ochsner, HR Talent Partner, is looking forward to receiving your cover letter.

What can you expect when applying to Hilti?

• We undertake to have all applications reviewed by one person. Even if no one is infallible, we stand by our person-centered approach to everything we do.

• Once you have submitted your application, you will receive automatic notifications from our system (triggered by our recruitment team).

• Applications that do not make it to the interview with a hiring manager do not receive personalized feedback.

• You can expect to hear from us within 2–3 weeks (on average) regardless of the result. The entire recruitment process can take between 5 and 6 weeks.

We wish you every success in your application process.
If technical problems occur during the application, please contact mycareer-techsupport@hilti.com.

Commitment to inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a central aspect of our way of working, our leadership style and our shared growth. We are actively committed to diversity of thought and an environment that is inclusive for everyone and everywhere. We continue to strive for every voice to be heard and for every team member to feel empowered to contribute. By building this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation and our impact to collectively improve construction.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation with more than 34,000 team members in 120 countries. Our goal is to improve construction. That’s why we care about learning, growing and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here you can contribute your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team and face meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you can turn your ideas into real achievements and growth through purposeful action, passion and teamwork.
